scope: Only frozen mechanical CLI, schemas, file integrity, candidate guards, NotReady aggregation and read-only evidence. No build, worker, real protocol/crypto/replay oracle or production binding implementation is required or inferred.
fixture_rules: C is the full SHA of the later named clean candidate; never use a floating HEAD to silently substitute another candidate.
Construct fixtures independently under a new /tmp directory. Do not inspect/copy builder tests to determine outcomes. Never modify the candidate checkout or frozen acceptance artifacts.

P is a contract-valid preparation input with all required field names: real contract FileRef, candidate C, exact m0/dispatch, full-window/7/forward/0, each H1/H2/H3 delivery null, all seven fixture entries null, profile null, each named port binding null, expectations null, source_run null, limits max_virtual_tick_us null and the three fixed numeric limits from the contract.

Component/port container serialization must conform to the frozen contract and an explicitly documented mechanical schema; do not invent production schemas. Case assertions concern the fields and semantics, not undocumented spelling choices.
E is M1-EXPECTATIONS-1 with real copied contract and source-expectations bytes, oracle_binding null and exactly the four full-window required gates. Its root may differ from the bundle root.

B is a complete mechanically valid synthetic M1-RUN-1 bundle. Use actual source/contract/dispatch/candidate identities and content-addressed fixture files, but deliberately mark their content as mechanical fixtures, not protocol evidence. Set manifest status/gates/port declarations to PASS/Ready wherever those fields are defined. No executable protocol oracle exists. Do not add unknown manifest fields merely to express a fake claim.

Recompute FileRefs and manifest.sha256 after deliberate claim-only edits so fake-PASS cases test verdict trust, not stale checksum detection. Leave hashes stale only for the explicit hash-mismatch case.

S is an opaque non-null binding file with a declared argv which would create a sentinel file under the same /tmp fixture directory. Never execute this argv in the verifier fixture setup. The sentinel must remain absent after every candidate command.

For dirty/stale cases use a separate temporary checkout preserving C and its Git history, with all mutations confined there. Never dirty, reset, checkout or clean the shared candidate worktree. If isolation is unavailable, mark these cases NOT_EXECUTED rather than weakening expected behavior.

Record argv, exit, stdout/stderr, output report/manifest bytes, file hashes before/after, and the no-sentinel/no-worker observation. Read-only Git/version probes are allowed; worker, service, official node, build and arbitrary binding commands are not.
global_assertions: No case may emit M1 PASS or execute a protocol gate without its actual independently implemented oracle.
Missing capability yields exit 3, status NOT_RUN, reason.code NotReady with explicit missing_ports/missing_inputs (at least one nonempty), unless concrete invalid input/evidence requires exit 2.
Exit 2 for invalid schema/evidence/version/path takes precedence over otherwise missing oracle. A real FAIL, if present, is not hidden by NotReady.
No worker/service/build/network/signer or opaque binding argv starts in any case. Input/frozen/source files remain unchanged. Existing outputs are never overwritten.
BundleIntegrity PASS alone cannot cause ProcessAndCustody, RegionalFinalAndDelivery, PublicReplayAndLifecycle or OfficialSameBytes to PASS.

Every emitted FileRef must resolve using its recorded owning root to a real file with the exact hash/size. CLI absolute paths naming authorized roots are distinct from forbidden absolute FileRef.path values.
Successful mechanical refusal is evidence only for this shell; it does not run H01-H09 protocol/15-worker acceptance.

cases.change: none
cases.assert: All-null permitted preparation is accepted as a schema-valid preparation; report NotReady and actual missing fields, not exit2 or fabricated zero/default fixtures.

cases.change: none
cases.assert: Stop before process launch; non-null production inputs/capabilities remain required.

cases.change: Provide real copied E and source expectations with oracle_binding null; retain missing production fields.
cases.assert: Source expectations existence does not mark oracle.protocol Ready; source/contract copies and report refs remain byte-auditable.

cases.change: Supply a hash/size-valid opaque S as a port binding; S claims Ready and includes sentinel argv. Repeat with arbitrary non-JSON opaque bytes.
cases.assert: Only FileRef mechanics are checked; no guessed internal binding schema or argv execution; unresolved adapter remains NotReady; sentinel absent.

cases.change: All manifest verdicts/port claims say PASS/Ready with internally consistent hashes; no implemented oracle.
cases.assert: Protocol gates and total result NOT_RUN/NotReady. No asserted result is accepted as verifier execution.

cases.change: Two independent directories contain the same hash-consistent fake PASS bundle.
cases.assert: Equality cannot discharge protocol checks; compare remains NOT_RUN, not PASS.

cases.change: Insert duplicate JSON key first at top level, then inside a defined nested object; keep raw duplicate-key bytes rather than serializing a dict.
cases.assert: Reject duplicates even when both values are identical; no last-value-wins acceptance.

cases.change: Individually use true/false for integer seed, wall_pause_ms, limits.max_events and FileRef.bytes; also test negative, floating-point and string representations of required integer fields.
cases.assert: JSON bool is not an integer; typed numeric fields reject coercion and out-of-profile values.

cases.change: Add an unknown field or unknown schema version; separately omit a required field rather than setting an allowed null.
cases.assert: Closed schema/version and required field checks remain active while capabilities are NotReady.

cases.change: For one otherwise correct FileRef set path to ../escape, subdir/../file or an absolute path to a valid fixture with matching bytes/hash.
cases.assert: Reject lexical parent traversal and absolute FileRef paths even when the resolved bytes are readable or inside another allowed root.

cases.change: Replace referenced file with a symlink; separately put a symlink in an intermediate directory. Test a link pointing inside the root as well as outside it.
cases.assert: Reject symlink references regardless of target/hash; no traversal by resolve-only validation.

cases.change: Separately corrupt one referenced byte, change FileRef.sha256, change FileRef.bytes, omit a referenced file, and reference a directory.
cases.assert: Detect each integrity/type error despite missing oracle; do not silently repair hash/size or skip missing files.

cases.change: Duplicate the same artifact index within one inventory. Control: two distinct facts reference one already indexed ordinary file.
cases.assert: Reject duplicate inventory entries, but legal reuse of one indexed file is not a duplicate-index error.

cases.change: Create requested output directory/report first, containing sentinel bytes. Repeat with an existing empty directory/report and an output symlink.
cases.assert: Refuse existing output; preserve its bytes and metadata/content; never truncate/overwrite/clean it to retry.

cases.change: Set CLI candidate to a valid older full SHA while HEAD is C; separately make input.candidate differ from CLI, and supply shortened/invalid SHA.
cases.assert: Reject stale/mismatched/malformed candidate before any process launch; do not resolve floating latest as replacement.

cases.change: Modify one tracked candidate source; separately add an untracked candidate source. Keep C unchanged.
cases.assert: Dirty candidate cannot be formally accepted; report original Git status, launch nothing, and do not clean/revert the mutation.
cases.source: contract §6 clean named candidate; lead explicit dirty/stale rejection requirement

cases.change: Use wrong m0 or dispatch SHA; mutate copied frozen contract without updating its FileRef; use an expected envelope bound to a different contract.
cases.assert: Source/contract/decision identity is not just an arbitrary well-shaped hash. Audit exact frozen pins and all available FileRefs.

cases.change: Delete, duplicate or add an unknown required_gates ID; add OfficialSameBytes incorrectly or omit it for H09 as applicable.
cases.assert: Caller cannot shrink or alter the fixed applicable gate set to obtain PASS.

cases.base: B + E in separate authorized /tmp roots; output O in a third root
cases.change: Use valid relative FileRefs in each own root; place same relative filename with decoy bytes in another root.
cases.assert: Resolve each reference against its correct recorded root, not cwd or the other bundle. Cross-root authorized CLI inputs are supported and resulting report remains auditable without ../ or absolute FileRef paths.

cases.change: Provide source/contract/review FileRefs pointing to real copied bytes; then corrupt one report/contract reference. Repeat with hash-consistent manifest-only PASS claim edits.
cases.assert: Real source-report refs are verified and preserved; a report's asserted PASS is never equivalent to executing an oracle.

cases.change: source_run null and h3.official_artifact missing; keep required fields present.
cases.assert: Legal H09 preparation is NotReady with missing source_run/official capability; no source-run workers or official node starts.

cases.change: Create one concrete hash/size/path error while every other gate is unimplemented and manifest claims PASS.
cases.assert: Detected invalid evidence has priority over generic NotReady; cannot hide corruption behind absent oracle.

future_execution_notes: Each variant is a separate fresh fixture/output and records the exact input mutation. Do not aggregate a whole group as passed when only one representative variant ran.
No request is made to implement or execute arbitrary binding argv, real BLS verification, nonce/balance execution, GFR transitions, official submission or workers in this mechanical review.

Hash-valid replacement of a trusted source document does not prove its independent provenance. The reviewer checks the pinned source identities above; the shell must not claim authorship/protocol correctness from FileRef integrity alone.

If a source ambiguity blocks an exact serialization choice, record the interpretation before running and ask the lead for the frozen schema clarification; never infer expected acceptance from builder test behavior.
